أتسلسل (form IIq)
# أَتَسَلْسَلُ (ʔatasalsalu) /ʔa.ta.sal.sa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
# أَتَسَلْسَلَ (ʔatasalsala) /ʔa.ta.sal.sa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
# أَتَسَلْسَلْ (ʔatasalsal) /ʔa.ta.sal.sal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
